svg.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: Sideband architecture
svg.desc: The Sideband CLI runs in one process: cli.py parses flags, engine.py talks to the user's engine over public HTTP routes, models.py holds the trace and report schema, canary.py encodes a bit as decode steps, measure.py is the single statistics path, replay.py calls the same function with a recorded trace, and report.py writes channel_budget.json, channel_budget.md and the probe trace.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: ARCHITECTURE / ONE PROCESS, ONE HTTP DEPENDENCY

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven modules around one public HTTP surface
